author: Inside Edition
description: Earlier this week, Inside Edition shared the story of Dominique Dillon, the Tennessee news anchor who was caught taking a quick nap live on the air. Today, a very-much-awake Dominique visited Inside Edition. She explained to Alison Hall that as a busy mom, sometimes it's just hard to keep your eyes open. There's data to back up her claim, as a recent survey found that 81% of working moms say they experience severe exhaustion as they balance commitments at work and home.
title: Wide Awake 'Sleeping Anchor' Visits Inside Edition

author: Inside Edition
description: Two brothers who were out on a fishing expedition got quite the shock when they reeled in a tiger shark. The surprise was especially big because they were in Massachusetts, where that breed of shark is usually not found. Tiger sharks are known for eating everything they can swallow, and they typically stick to warmer, tropical waters. Their presence off the coast of New England is leading to a warming for beachgoers.
title: Warning After Brothers Reel In Tiger Shark Off Massachusetts

author: Inside Edition
description: President Trump is on the West Coast today, at his golf club in Los Angeles, California. His visit comes just days after a man was arrested at the course for allegedly acting suspiciously. A loaded gun was also found in his car, authorities said. According to county jail records, the man is being held without bail. Inside Edition's Brooke Anderson has more on what we've learned about  what's being called a foiled assassination attempt.
title: Man Arrested At Trump's Los Angeles Golf Club Had Loaded Gun In Car: Authorities

author: Inside Edition
description: Imagine seeing a scary-looking clown on your doorbell security camera when it's nowhere near Halloween. That's what happened to a number of families in a Missouri neighborhood. They got an even bigger shock when cops said that a knife-wielding teen in a clown costume was taken into custody in connection with a homicide investigation. With the suspect in custody, police have announced there is no longer a public threat to the East St. Louis community.
title: Knife-Wielding Teen In Clown Costume Arrested In Connection With Homicide

author: Inside Edition
description: Donna Mills was a sex symbol back in the 1980s, starring as Abby Cunningham on the primetime drama "Knots Landing." Mills is still turning heads at age 85, and what's really making mouths drop is the fact that she has an account on the racy website OnlyFans. Mills isn't alone, the site says there are more than 4.6 million creator accounts. So how far is this octogenarian willing to go? Mills spoke with Inside Edition's Ann Mercogliano.
title: 85-Year-Old Donna Mills Has An OnlyFans Account

author: Inside Edition
description: There was more drama today at the Lindsay Clancy trial in Massachusetts. Clancy is accused of killing her three young children during what she says was a moment of postpartum psychosis. Clancy's former nanny took the stand and was asked about her employer's mental state. If convicted, Clancy will face life in prison without a chance of parole. She has pleaded not guilty. Her trial is expected to wrap up next week. Inside Edition's Ann Mercogliano has more.
title: Nanny Testifies About Lindsay Clancy's Mental State

author: Inside Edition
description: A town in Serbia is getting a glance at history. Low water levels in Prahovo have revealed the remains of German ships used during World War II. Reports say about 20 ships are visible from the banks of the Danube in current conditions. Some residents are taking the opportunity to explore the relics while they can. The water levels are a cause for concern. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: 20 WWII Shipwrecks Visible In Danube Due To Low Water

author: Inside Edition
description: A mugging at a fast food restaurant didn't go unchallenged, when bystanders stepped up to stop it. The Tucson Police in Arizona released this video of the incident. They say a 34-year-old man tried to steal a backpack from a 70-year-old man. During the struggle, the elderly man fell to the ground and that's when witnesses immediately jumped into action. Cops say three good Samaritans intervened and chased the suspect out of the restaurant. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Good Samaritans Stop Elderly Man From Getting Robbed

author: Inside Edition
description: A passenger train slammed into a trailer that had stopped in the tracks. The dramatic incident happened in Poland, and was caught on surveillance cameras. Polish State Railways released the footage. It shows a tractor hauling trailers of hay bales traveling across the tracks as a barrier closes. The tractor cruises through, knocking down one of the barriers. But then, inexplicably, it stops moving. Moments later, a speeding train runs right into it.
title: Train With 500 Passengers Slams Into Drunk Tractor Driver's Hay Trailer
